0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1) are 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, but they lost their most recent game, while the Pacers (2-2) sit 8th in the East and 3rd in the Central, 1.5 games back. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker and Tacko Fall, and Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy and T.J. McConnell, with Andrew Nembhard listed as day-to-day with neck soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 76ers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
